newsitem.title: FRANCE: French July-Sep grain use in feed seen up 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: French July-Sep grain use in feed seen up 10.8 pct.

text.p: Use of French grain in animal feed jumped 10.8 percent in the first three months of the 1996/97 campaign (July/June) compared with the same period for 1995/96, data prepared ahead of the monthly meeting of France's grain office ONIC showed.

The data, subject to approval by ONIC members before publication on November 13, suggest total grain use in feed reached 2.231 million tonnes between July 1 and September 30, 1996 against 2.014 million in the same period for 1995/96.
Grain use in feed between July 1 and September 30, 1996 breaks down as follows (in '000 tonnes)
soft wheat barley maize durum grain total
ONIC predicted last month that some 9.3 million tonnes of grain would be fed to animals in the whole 1996/97 season, an increase of 11.1 percent over the past season.
ONIC estimated that wheat usage would lead the way, with a 7.4 percent increase to six million tonnes.
Barley usage was put at 1.1 million tonnes and maize usage at 2.2 million tonnes.
